title: 🆕 New Pair: 0x587963b6c3f4277a92... on robinhood
summary:
RONS is a rebase protocol on Robinhood Chain, an EVM Layer 2 built on the Arbitrum Orbit stack. It launches on pons_v2 and is partnered with pons. Supply is 1,000,000,000 and fixed. The entire supply mints to the bonding curve at deploy, so there is no presale, no team allocation and nothing minted to the deployer.

Say it like runs. A relay has one rule: the baton moves or the race is over. That is the mechanism rather than a metaphor. Every eight hours the supply passes the baton and every balance moves by the same proportion in the same block.

A lap is eight hours, three a day, twenty one a week. At each boundary the total supply is multiplied by the published factor. This is a single state change across the whole supply, not a distribution sent wallet by wallet. Balances are held as shares, so every wallet reads a larger number in the same block, with no claim step, no transaction to sign and no gas to pay. No queue, no allowlist, nobody early and nobody late.

The pre-stake is capped twice. Pool capacity is 88,000,000 RONS and no single wallet may pre-stake more than 2,800,000. A pre-stake that one wallet can absorb is a private sale with additional steps. Pre-staking is a plain ERC-20 transfer to the vault: no contract call, no allowance and no spend permission is granted, and every position is independently verifiable from Transfer logs. Unstaking returns tokens one for one, with no lock and no cooldown.

A rebase does not increase the fraction of supply a holder owns. It multiplies every balance by the same factor, so the count moves and the share does not. That is stated on the site rather than omitted from it. The schedule is public, mechanical and identical for every wallet.

The rate is fixed at launch and published with the contract. The contract address is published on the site and on X at launch, not before.

The run never stops.
